query_evaluations.query: What does 23CSE302T cover and when is its exam?
query_evaluations.answer: 23CSE302T covers Advanced Data Structures including binary search trees and graph algorithms. The Mid-Semester Examination I is scheduled from 12 September 2026 to 16 September 2026 for all undergraduate programs.

query_evaluations.query: What are the attendance and laboratory requirements?
query_evaluations.answer: Under regulation R23, students must maintain a minimum of 75% attendance to be eligible for end-semester examinations. Students must also achieve 85% on all laboratory experiments to avoid detention.
